decision: retain; two-field constructor loops improve 34.8% in an 11-pair M4 instruction-retirement comparison; empty construction is unchanged, so constructor allocation/prototype lookup remains a separate target

source.candidate_also_contains: An independent RegExp replacement change was present in the candidate binary; the measured constructor loops do not execute RegExp code.

measurement.kind: 11-pair M4 production CJS instruction-retirement A/B with per-build empty-loop control
measurement.script: (function(){function P(a,b){this.x=a;this.y=b;}var last;for(var t=0;t<100;t++)for(var i=0;i<10000;i++)last=new P(i,null);if(last.x!==9999||last.y!==null)throw new Error('constructor result');})();
measurement.matched_control: (function(){function P(a,b){this.x=a;this.y=b;}var last=0;for(var t=0;t<100;t++)for(var i=0;i<10000;i++)last=i;if(last!==9999)throw new Error('control result');})();
measurement.normalization: Subtract each binary's matched empty-loop instruction count. Pair order alternated by round. The report uses medians and paired bootstrap 95% intervals.
measurement.scope_limit: Microbenchmark evidence isolates property-add costs; there is not yet a post-change V8-v7 fixture confirmation or Task 61 qualification. The empty-constructor control shows this cache does not explain or improve the remaining allocation/prototype-lookup overhead.

implementation: At an eligible SetField site, learn source shape to target shape and slot after the generic first add. The add hit checks the receiver source shape, extensibility, and the recorded ordinary-prototype shape chain before pushing the value and installing the target shape. Proxy, namespace, arguments, dictionary, deep-chain, inherited accessor/read-only, and non-extensible cases retain the generic path. SetThisFieldStrict and SetThisField share set_field_cached, so constructor field stores use the same cache. Cache storage is included in the existing field-cache memory report.

source_review: SetThisFieldStrict and SetThisField dispatch through set_field_cached (vm/dispatch.rs:736).
The cache is trained only after the existing semantic path succeeds; inherited setters and non-writable properties are excluded.
Shape changes on the prototype chain invalidate the chain guard; descriptor mutation, prototype replacement, and shape compaction clear or invalidate the cache.
Class field definitions use a separate define-own-property path.
